meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会为 pi 创建、查看并更新长期目标记录;逐项核对成果后才标记完成,否则标记为预算用尽。
howto.when: 当你明确要求设定、继续、审计等长期目标操作时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个长期目标:完成新功能开发。
say.note: 会创建目标记录,开始跟踪进度。

say.text: 看看我现在的目标进展如何?
say.note: 会调用查看工具,返回当前目标状态。

say.text: 把“发布v1.0”这个目标标记为完成。
say.note: 若证据不足会要求补充,不会直接完成。

howto.what_en: Claude creates, inspects, and updates persistent goal records for pi. It marks a goal complete only after verifying all requirements with evidence, otherwise it may mark it as budget-limited.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to set, continue, audit, or manage a long-running goal.

say_en.text: Help me create a long-term goal: finish the new feature.
say_en.note: It will create a goal record and start tracking.

say_en.text: How is my current goal progressing?
say_en.note: It will inspect and return the goal status.

say_en.text: Mark the goal 'release v1.0' as complete.
say_en.note: It won't complete without enough evidence.
